sentence: This project builds molecular, microfluidic, and computational tools to study how fluid transport in the microenvironment of cells regulates biological processes.
This project studies how injury-detecting sensory neurons cause chronic pain after spinal cord injury and surgical injury.
This project identifies vascular senescent cells in multiple tissues and studies how they relate to secreted proteins in the blood.
This project tries to find out which factors let outer membrane vesicles of Gram-negative bacteria enter macrophages.
This project tries to restore the function of mitochondria and cilia in Joubert syndrome, a rare form of retinal degeneration in children.
This project studies how the apical extracellular matrix regulates tube dimensions in the Drosophila salivary gland.
This project measures estrogen and androgen levels in the circulation and sex hormones in the gut that gut microbiota have reactivated.
This project studies how a long non-coding RNA causes oncogenic phenotypes in lung cancer patients.
This project studies a metabolite of tryptophan metabolism and its immunosuppressive effects in animal models of Psoriasis.
This project studies how immune and epithelial interactions in the airway lead to severe asthma that resists treatment by corticosteroids.
This project studies the role of mechanosensitive ion channels in glaucoma and how human variants in their genes may be associated with glaucoma risk.
This project tests whether hypoxia in the womb primes the developing skin to react to later inflammation and tissue injury.
This project studies how osteoclasts mature and how they contribute to pathogenic bone loss under inflammatory conditions.
This project studies individual, interpersonal, and neighborhood factors that may contribute to differences in hypertensive disorders of pregnancy outcomes between Black and White women.
This project builds a platform for three-dimensional pathology of breast and prostate cancer using tissue clearing, two-photon microscopy, and machine-learning-based analysis.
This project studies how copy number variants make pathogenic yeast resistant to antifungal drugs and how they affect fitness and gene expression.
This project tries to find out how cancer cells escape macrophage surveillance.
This project develops strategies to permanently edit a gene using CRISPR so it produces full-length Survival Motor Neuron protein in spinal muscular atrophy.
This project studies how inflammasome activation in HIV infection drives stroke susceptibility.
This project records video and electrographic data and collects tissues from swine with or without post-traumatic epilepsy.
